name: Elongated Talons
body:
Your claws grow longer and sharper than those of your smaller brethren.

Prerequisites: Claw attack, hulk racial trait, lizardfolk.

Benefit: Your claw damage increases by 1 size category.

This stacks with the damage increase granted by Improved Natural Attack.
